name: comp-45
title: OTP Double Input
blurb: 6-digit OTP input split into two groups of 3.
description: An OTP field with 6 slots split by a minus icon into two groups. Built with input-otp. Each slot is a 9x9 box showing the active state with ring.
use_when: Phone number, license plate, or other formatted code entry.
avoid_when: The groups need to be dynamic or differently sized.
a11y: Label linked to input. Active slot gets ring focus. Minus icon marked aria-hidden.
